lead.title: NHS England awards Kainos £9.9M to build the NHS Online "virtual hospital" (alpha phase 2)
lead.deck: Kainos will deliver clinician workflow tooling and integrations with national NHS systems and the NHS App for the UK's first fully digital hospital. The contract may also cover short, outcome-based statements of work.

milestone.company: North West London Acute Provider Group
milestone.title: Four London hospital trusts sound out the market for an ambient voice technology (AI scribe) for 2027-2030
milestone.summary: Imperial College Healthcare, Chelsea and Westminster, London North West and Hillingdon are seeking a supplier; the estimated contract runs from April 1, 2027 to March 31, 2030. Value not disclosed.
milestone.why: A multi-hospital group purchase: a sign AI scribes are moving from isolated pilots to regional tenders, which concentrates the market around a few suppliers.

brefsIntl.title: Brellium raises $23M (Left Lane Capital, First Round) and launches CortexLM, guaranteed against payer clawbacks
brefsIntl.summary: The AI reviews 100% of patient notes before billing; if a payer claws back a cleared visit, Brellium covers the cost.

brefsIntl.title: Readily raises $11M Series A led by Define Ventures for its health-plan compliance platform
brefsIntl.summary: Clients are health plans covering more than 25 million lives in 46 states, including L.A. Care Health Plan in production. Y Combinator participates.

brefsIntl.title: Rock Health: US digital health raised $11.1B so far this year (358 deals), $3.7B in Q3
brefsIntl.summary: Average deal size of $31M ($29.5M in 2025); 45 M&A transactions in Q3, 164 year to date.

word.definition: All the steps that turn care into payment: coding, billing, compliance checks and denial management; AI aims to fix errors before the invoice is sent.

how.t: Care is recorded in the patient file and then coded.
An engine re-reads the case and flags missing diagnoses or supporting evidence.
The invoice goes to the payer, with fewer denials or after-the-fact clawbacks.

word.why: A massive administrative budget, measurable euro gains and short sales cycles: the VC angle is billing as a wedge into hospital software, with outcome guarantees increasingly offered.
